name: Cosmo Electronics Corporation
summary: Cosmo Electronics Corporation engages in the manufacturing and sale of relays and photocouplers, and LEDs Taiwan, the United States, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through Optoelectronic Parts; LED Lighting; and Energy & Materials segments. It offers photo couplers, SSR-MOSFET output, reed relay, and solid-state relay products. The company is also involved in trading of electronic products; manufacturing and selling of LED lighting, material of biomass energy, and new electronic parts; processing and trading of PCBs and routers; and land development business, as well as developing, manufacturing, and selling of electronic products.
